$comment: Copy to ~/.pi-jupyter/config.json — env vars take precedence over this file.
$comment.kernelName: Must be a kernelspec *name* (see GET /api/kernelspecs): e.g. "python3", or "ir" for R — NOT a display name like "R".
$comment.extras: Optional fields: "workingDir": "/path/to/project" (base for relative save paths), "timeoutRestartKernel": true (auto-restart a kernel still busy after a timeout; state is lost), and "bindSession": true (bind the kernel to an /api/sessions row so it shows up in the Jupyter Running UI; defaults to true).
